questions.question: Simple interest on a given sum for 3 years at a rate of 17% per year is ₹7,140 less than the simple interest on the same sum for 5 years. Find the sum.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in **Time** = 5 years − 3 years = 2 years

Difference in **Simple Interest** percentage = 2 years × 17% = 34%

Given, 34% of the **Sum** = ₹7,140

1% of the **Sum** = 7,140 ÷ 34 = ₹210

100% of the **Sum** = 210 × 100 = ₹21,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹21,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Rate** (R) = 17%, **Time₁** (T₁) = 3 years, **Time₂** (T₂) = 5 years, Difference in **Simple Interest** = ₹7,140.

**Formula Used:** Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e93c37e4bd45a618296962aea3c96965c28c06b5cb5587e14c2ee50b7c7ffd0a.png] 

⇒ SI₂ − SI₁ = 7,140

⇒ [(P × 17 × 5) ÷ 100] − [(P × 17 × 3) ÷ 100] = 7,140

⇒ (85P − 51P) ÷ 100 = 7,140

⇒ 34P ÷ 100 = 7,140

⇒ P = (7,140 × 100) ÷ 34

⇒ P = 210 × 100

⇒ P = 21,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹21,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concept

Simple interest is calculated only on the initial **Principal** sum. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P = Principal, R = Rate, and T = Time.

Direct Proportionality

For a constant **Principal** and **Rate**, **Simple Interest** is directly proportional to the **Time** duration (SI ∝ T).

Difference in Interest

Difference in interest for different periods can be calculated as: ΔSI = (P × R × ΔT) ÷ 100.

Total Amount

The total amount (A) at the end of the period is the sum of the Principal and the Simple Interest: A = P + SI = P(1 + RT/100).

Cost of painting = Total surface area × Rate of painting

⇒ Area of both ends = 2 × (22/7) × (0.4² - 0.3²)

questions.question: The marked price of a table is ₹10,500, and it was sold for ₹9,450. Find the percentage discount for this transaction.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **Discount** amount: 10,500 − 9,450 = 1,050.

Observe the relationship: 1,050 is exactly **one-tenth** of 10,500.

Ratio method: 1,050/10,500 = 1/10 = 10%.

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Marked Price (MP)** = ₹10,500

**Selling Price (SP)** = ₹9,450

**Formula Used:**

**Discount** = **Marked Price** − **Selling Price**

**Discount %** = (**Discount** / **Marked Price**) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9901a2c9b335f4a14c4fc0bd5522945bf1163af7f33fe653316fce8e62a611e0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Discount** = 10,500 − 9,450 = 1,050

⇒ **Discount %** = (1,050 / 10,500) × 100

⇒ **Discount %** = (1 / 10) × 100

⇒ **Discount %** = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP)

The price printed on an item or the label price. Also known as the List Price.

Net Selling Price

The final amount the buyer pays after the discount is subtracted: SP = MP × (100 − D%)/100.

Successive Discounts

When multiple discounts d₁, d₂ are applied, the effective discount is d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂)/100.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about average?

options.text: The average of six consecutive even integers is an even natural number
The average of six consecutive odd integers is an odd integer.
The average of six consecutive odd integers is an even integer.
The average of six consecutive odd integers is an odd natural number.

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Six consecutive odd integers

**Formula used:**

Average of n consecutive integers = Median of the sequence

**Calculation:**

Let the six consecutive odd integers be:

a, a+2, a+4, a+6, a+8, a+10

The median of these integers (since they are in sequence) is the average of the 3rd and 4th terms:

⇒ Median = (a+4 + a+6)/2

⇒ Median = (2a + 10)/2

⇒ Median = a + 5

Since a is an odd integer, a+5 will be even.

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

questions.question: Ajit walks around a circular field at the speed of two rounds per hour, while Mohit runs around it at the speed of 10 rounds per hour. They start in the same direction from the same point at 6:30 a.m. Find the time at which they cross each other.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ajit's speed = 2 rounds/hour

Mohit's speed = 10 rounds/hour

Start time = 6:30 a.m.

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed (same direction) = Speed of faster person - Speed of slower person

Time to cross = Distance (1 round) / Relative speed

**Calculations:**

Relative speed = 10 - 2 = 8 rounds/hour

Time to cross = 1 round / 8 rounds/hour = 1/8 hour

1/8 hour = (1/8) × 60 minutes = 7.5 minutes

Crossing time = Start time + Time to cross

Crossing time = 6:30 a.m. + 7.5 minutes = 6:37:30 a.m.

**∴ They cross each other at 6:37:30 a.m.**

questions.question: Nife layer of earth is situated in the ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Core**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Nife layer of the Earth refers to its **inner core** and **outer core**, which are primarily composed of Nickel (Ni) and Iron (Fe).
 
• The Earth's core is divided into a solid inner core and a liquid outer core.
 
• The inner core has a radius of about 1,220 kilometers, while the outer core extends up to about 3,400 kilometers.
 
• The core is the hottest part of the Earth, with temperatures reaching up to 5,700 K (5,430 °C).
 
• The movement of the liquid outer core generates the Earth's magnetic field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Earth's Layers:**

 
 
• The Earth is composed of three main layers: the crust, the mantle, and the core.
 
• The crust is the outermost layer, the mantle lies beneath the crust, and the core is the innermost layer.
 
• The mantle is made of silicate rocks that are rich in magnesium and iron.
 
 
 
• **Geological Terminology:**
 
 
• The lithosphere includes the crust and the uppermost part of the mantle.
 
• The asthenosphere is a semi-fluid layer upon which the lithosphere floats.
 
 
 
• **Magnetic Field:**
 
 
• The Earth's magnetic field is generated by the movement of molten iron and nickel in the outer core.
 
• This magnetic field protects the Earth from solar winds and cosmic radiation.
 
 
 
• **Plate Tectonics:**
 
 
• The movement of tectonic plates is driven by the heat from the Earth's core.
 
• This movement causes earthquakes, volcanic activity, and the formation of mountain ranges.

questions.question: Which of the following crops that spread to northern India in the early years of the 17th century was NOT mentioned in the Ain-i-Akbari in the lists of crops in northern India?

__
 
• Function of President – France (Incorrect)
 
 
• India’s President is largely ceremonial (like UK), not executive.
 
• France has a semi-presidential system—its President holds real powers.
 
• Indian model is based on British parliamentary system, not French.
 
• Indian President acts on the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Basis for Indian Constitution’s legal system and Article 14.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements are correct about Ribosomes?

Statement A: Ribosomes have no membrane.

Statement B: Digestive hydrolytic enzymes are present in Ribosomes.

Statement C: These are called suicidal bags.

Statement D: Ribosomes play an important role in protein synthesis.

options.text: Only statements A, B and C

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only statements A and D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ribosomes have no membrane**: Ribosomes are composed of RNA and proteins and do not have a surrounding membrane. They are found in both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells.
 
• **Ribosomes play an important role in protein synthesis**: They facilitate the linking of amino acids to form polypeptides, following the instructions encoded in messenger RNA (mRNA).
 
• Ribosomes can be found either floating freely in the cytoplasm or bound to the endoplasmic reticulum, forming rough ER.
 
• There are two main types of ribosomes: 70S (found in prokaryotes) and 80S (found in eukaryotes).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Digestive hydrolytic enzymes**: These enzymes are found in lysosomes, not ribosomes. Lysosomes are membrane-bound organelles that contain enzymes for breaking down cellular waste and macromolecules.
 
• **Suicidal bags**: Lysosomes are often referred to as "suicidal bags" because they can digest the cell's own components when they rupture.
 
• **Messenger RNA (mRNA)**: This type of RNA carries genetic information from DNA to the ribosome, where it is translated into a specific protein sequence.
 
• **Transfer RNA (tRNA)**: tRNA is responsible for bringing the correct amino acids to the ribosome during protein synthesis, matching the codons in the mRNA.
 
• **Ribosomal RNA (rRNA)**: This RNA forms the core of the ribosome's structure and catalyzes protein synthesis.

questions.question: The Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY) was launched by which Ministry of Government of India in the year 2016?

• **Employee Pension Scheme (EPS)**
 
 
• EPS is a pension scheme managed by the EPFO, aimed at providing pension benefits to employees in the organized sector after retirement.
 
• It is funded by diverting 8.33% of the employer's contribution from the employee's EPF account.
 
 
 
• **Skill India Mission**

questions.question: What cellular structure is responsible for breaking down and recycling cellular components and molecules?

• Lysosomes are membrane-bound organelles found in animal cells.
 
• They contain hydrolytic enzymes that break down biomolecules, including proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and lipids.
 
• They are often referred to as the "digestive system" of the cell due to their role in breaking down cellular waste and debris.
 
• Lysosomes are essential for cellular homeostasis, recycling cellular components through a process known as autophagy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• It plays a crucial role in cellular responses to stress and starvation.
 
 
 
• **Enzymatic Function:**
 
 
• Lysosomal enzymes are acidic hydrolases that function optimally at acidic pH.
 
• The acidic environment inside lysosomes is maintained by proton pumps in the lysosomal membrane.
 
 
 
• **Lysosomal Storage Diseases:**
 
 
• Lysosomal storage diseases are genetic disorders caused by the malfunction of lysosomal enzymes.
 
• Examples include Tay-Sachs disease, Gaucher's disease, and Pompe disease.
 
 
 
• **Role in Immune Response:**
 
 
• Lysosomes play a role in the immune response by digesting pathogens engulfed by phagocytic cells.
 
• They fuse with phagosomes to form phagolysosomes, where pathogens are degraded.
